messages:
marco: quick copy review for the 'Disable automatic model updates' modal in the Deployment settings. want wording that's clear about risk and what happens after disabling. current draft below.

marco: Current draft:
Title: Disable auto-updates?
Body: Turning this off prevents automatic model updates. You will need to update models manually.
Primary: Disable
Secondary: Cancel

marco: concerns: 'Disable' is vague, and 'prevent' feels negative without context. we should surface risk (security/bug fixes) and a safe fallback (re-enable or schedule).

anya: +1. suggest explicit verb + object in CTA: 'Turn off automatic updates' or 'Disable automatic updates for this deployment'. Also add a short line: 'Recommended for stable production only.'

leo: i like explicitness. propose small rewrite:
Title: Turn off automatic model updates
Body: Your deployment will stop receiving automatic model updates (including security and performance fixes). You can re-enable updates at any time or apply updates manually. Recommended for locked/stable production workloads.
Primary: Turn off updates
Secondary: Cancel

accessibility-bot: a11y note: avoid using only 'Turn off'—screen readers need context. include full aria-label on primary: 'Turn off automatic model updates for deployment X'. ensure focus lands on modal and include role=dialog.

anya: tone nit: 'stop receiving' -> 'stop getting' is less formal. prefer 'stop receiving'. also shorten the sentence: keep first line as the risk, second line as the action/fallback.

marco: condensed suggestion to use in Figma:
Title: Turn off automatic model updates
Body: This will stop your deployment from receiving automatic updates (security and performance fixes). You can re-enable updates or apply updates manually at any time. Recommended for stable production workloads.
Primary: Turn off updates
Secondary: Cancel

leo: small UI note: for deployments with recent critical fixes, show a tiny alert line: 'This deployment received a critical fix 3 days ago' to help decision. for copy, maybe append: 'Recent critical fixes may be missed.'

accessibility-bot: also add an inline help link: 'Learn about update policy' with accessible link text. for keyboard users ensure the modal has a clear cancel target and Esc closes.

marco: good catches. i'll update the Figma with the condensed wording, add aria-label per bot, and a small conditional alert for recent critical fixes. i'll open a short copy ticket and ping PM for sign-off. if no objections by EOD reply here. :thumbsup:

anya: :+1:

leo: :thumbsup:
